newsitem.title: USA: Iraq cancels Basrah cargoes for total 2.2 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: Iraq cancels Basrah cargoes for total 2.2 mln bbls.

text.p: Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organization (SOMO) has cancelled two cargoes of Basrah Light crude oil at the last minute, even though the shipments had been given the green light from the United Nations sanctions committee, sources said Wednesday.

The two shipments, a 900,000 barrel cargo due to begin loading Wednesday for Nippon Oil Co, and a 1.3 million barrel tanker due to load in early June for Bayoil of the U.S., had received U.N. approval only last Friday.
They had been held up because of worries the proceeds might overshoot the $2.14 billion allowed under the "oil-for-food" deal.
"SOMO cancelled," said a U.N. source, without elaborating.
"Everyone inolved in this can't understand why the Iraqis would cancel these cargoes once the U.N. had given agreement," said a source involved in the deal.
